headlines.title: Supreme Court rejects Republicans’ Missouri redistricting push for third time
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — For the third time, the Supreme Court on Friday shut down efforts by Missouri Republicans to use a new congressional map in the midterm elections that are already underway.

headlines.title: Supreme Court allows Trump administration to use expanded database for potential voter purges
headlines.description: The Supreme Court permitted the Trump administration to expand a federal database containing citizenship information, as it encourages states to purge people from voter rolls.

headlines.title: States of emergency as powerful nor’easter bears down
headlines.description: Destructive waves are slamming the East Coast and flood waters are submerging streets as a voluntary evacuation is issued. NBC News’ Sam Brock is in the storm zone.

headlines.title: Even as a new ‘Great British Bake Off’ judge, Nigella Lawson can’t escape the memes
headlines.description: “Great British Bake Off” fans were excited about Nigella Lawson’s debut on season 17 of the baking competition show. But many also poked fun at her mannerisms.

headlines.title: Filmed in Captivity: Inside Russia’s Prison Propaganda Machine
headlines.description: Russian captors force Ukrainian prisoners of war to record propaganda videos designed to rally domestic support for the invasion and sow division within Ukraine. The videos often haunt former captives long after their release. NBC News’ Jane Lytvynenko travels to Ukraine to uncover how this propaganda influences local communities and the lives of returning soldiers.

headlines.title: New data shows most women in the Marines passing toughened fitness tests for combat roles
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he wanted women in combat roles to be held to the same physical standards as men. One year later, new numbers from the Marine Corps show most women in combat roles are meeting, or exceeding those standards. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Lawmakers slam Trump’s ‘unlawful’ move to cut $810 million in federal funds
headlines.description: The White House said Friday that it planned to cut $810 million in bipartisan, congressionally approved funding, spurring criticism from lawmakers on both sides of the aisle.

headlines.title: Hurricane Nolo expected to bring heavy rain as it skirts Hawaii’s Big Island
headlines.description: NAALEHU, Hawaii — Hurricane Nolo is forecast to strengthen into a major hurricane in the Pacific Ocean over the weekend, unleashing intense rain, the possibility of life-threatening flash flooding, and dangerous surf for Hawaii’s Big Island.
